investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumix Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Google Cloud asia-southeast1 (zones asia-southeast1-a/asia-southeast1-b/asia-southeast1-c); network range 10.88.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster lumix-prod-asiaso (GKE); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 12gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the export-worker PostgreSQL database export-db-01; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
